# Soumik Chatterjee

> AI Specialist in Kolkata. I help individuals and teams use AI for work, especially automations, and then ensure that nothing breaks in the future. Three kinds of work, community and member support, AI workflows, part-time AI training.

Soumik Chatterjee is looking for a full-time role in community and member support, AI workflows or AI training, remote from Kolkata, India. Contract work on single workflows is also available. Can start immediately.

## Results

- 9 prospecting pipelines, 2,314 contacts and $1.47M CAD of prospect pipeline in 90 days for a Toronto founder (contract, Feb 2026 to present). The founder estimates 20 to 30 hours a month saved.
- 400+ instructor community across India, the US, UK, UAE and Australia at CampK12 (2020 to 2023). Manual outreach down 30%, client retention above 90%.
- Python test automation for Bank of America and UCI Hospital at Accenture (2015 to 2019). Post-deployment defects down 15%.
- 31 hiring partners signed against a target of 25 at Navgurukul (Mar to Apr 2026), 2,093 companies contacted.
- 12 AI tools and 2 Chrome extensions live, all free. Extensions have 300+ users.
- 1,200+ students mentored since 2016. Teaching assistant on the Oxford Programme in Strategic Analysis and Decision-Making with AI via Simplilearn (Oct 2026 to Sep 2027).
